name: Tal Afar

queries.query: Tal Afar Iraq cadastral parcel map land registry official GIS
queries.result: Found the official Iraqi Ministry of Justice contact directory naming the Tal Afar Real Estate Registration Directorate; found the official Ur portal deed-and-property-map procedure; no public parcel viewer or anonymous geometry endpoint was found. Search also found official investment/planning material mentioning Tal Afar plots, but those are opportunity/project records rather than a city cadastral layer.

queries.query: تلعفر العراق خارطة عقارية سجل عقاري كادستر
queries.result: Found the same first-party Ministry of Justice Tal Afar registry office and the official Arabic Ur procedure for requesting a deed and property map. The procedure states service availability was initially limited to Baghdad and would expand later; no anonymous Tal Afar parcel geometry was exposed.

registryBasis: The official Ministry of Justice directory explicitly lists مديرية تسجيل عقاري تلعفر (Tal Afar Real Estate Registration Directorate) and provides a tilafer_iqari@moj.gov.iq contact. The official Ur service describes requesting a property deed and property map from the competent real-estate registration directorate. This establishes local registry custody, not open geometry access.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Downloaded and inspected first-party directory; confirmed the Tal Afar registry-office entry and contact address.
Direct request returned an anti-automation/error response; search-rendered official page content was recorded separately. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, or credentials used.
Public ASP.NET catalog page loaded; inspected source and found no parcel geometry endpoint or safe parcel field schema.
Public urban-planning map shell loaded; inspected JavaScript and found base/overlay map code, but no cadastral parcel service or bounded feature response.

Official investment-map page blocked the direct request. Search-indexed official results mention Tal Afar plot numbers, but these are project/opportunity references outside the target city parcel-source qualification and were not retained as parcel geometry.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Tal Afar local real-estate registration custody is evidenced; public deed/map request documentation and general government map catalogs were checked.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if later exposed
blocker: No anonymous, geometry-bearing Tal Afar cadastral service was verified. The first-party registry procedure is owner/agent-facing and the public map catalogs exposed no parcel layer, schema, CRS, or safe ID+geometry response.
remainingUncertainty: A local registry or another government unit may hold parcel maps or digitized cadastral data not publicly exposed through the checked pages. The exact WUP point was not used to infer absence, and no exact-point or citywide parcel hit/miss was claimed.
nextStep: Retry first-party public service discovery when the Ur/IGP interfaces expose a documented anonymous map/API route; qualify only after obtaining a bounded Tal Afar geometry-plus-native-ID response with CRS and source scope.
